# Configurable Keyboard Shortcuts System

## Problem

Keyboard shortcuts are hardcoded in `useKeyboardShortcuts.ts`. Users need configurable shortcuts with:
- Two key bindings per action (primary + secondary)
- Settings UI for visual configuration
- Conflict detection and resolution

**Blocked task**: `fn-5-jef.7` waiting for this infrastructure.

## Scope

**Configurable actions by category:**

| Category | Actions |
|----------|---------|
| Tools | select, pan, zoom, quick_zoom (spring-loaded), draw, delete, merge, measure, move_section, move_station |
| Edit | undo, redo, save |
| View | toggle_depth_gradient, toggle_grid, toggle_satellite, toggle_labels, fit_to_bounds, zoom_in, zoom_out |
| Panels | toggle_sections_panel, toggle_detail_panel, toggle_data_table |

## Key Decisions

- **Config format**: Array of strings per action: `["S", "Shift+S"]` (max 2)
- **Validation**: Parse "Ctrl+S" format, fall back to defaults on invalid
- **Migration**: Old single-string config moves to primary slot
- **Conflict handling**: Prevent duplicates, show error with option to rebind
- **Spring-loaded**: Separate `quick_zoom` entry from `zoom` toggle
- **Platform display**: Show ⌘ on Mac, Ctrl on Windows/Linux
- **Recording UI**: Click to focus, press keys, Escape cancels

## Quick commands

```bash
pnpm tsc --noEmit
pnpm test:ui
cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
```

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Rust `ShortcutsConfig` uses `Vec<String>` (max 2) per action
- [ ] Validation parses shortcut format, falls back to defaults
- [ ] Migration preserves existing single-binding config
- [ ] TypeScript types mirror Rust schema
- [ ] `useKeyboardShortcuts` reads from config instead of hardcoded
- [ ] Supports multiple bindings per action
- [ ] Separate zoom toggle vs quick_zoom spring-loaded
- [ ] Settings UI has Shortcuts tab with search, categories
- [ ] Key recording with visual feedback
- [ ] Conflict detection shows conflicting action
- [ ] Reset per-action and global
- [ ] ARIA accessibility (labels, live regions)
- [ ] Toast feedback configurable (None/Non-obvious/All)
- [ ] Rust unit tests for parsing, validation, migration
- [ ] TypeScript unit tests for shortcut matching, conflicts
- [ ] Playwright E2E for recording, conflicts, reset, persistence
- [ ] WebdriverIO accessibility tests
- [ ] docs/configuration.md updated

## References

- `src-tauri/src/config/mod.rs:L405-419` - Current ShortcutsConfig
- `src/types/config.ts:L153-166` - TypeScript ShortcutsConfig
- `src/hooks/useKeyboardShortcuts.ts` - Hardcoded shortcuts
- `src/components/Dialogs/SettingsDialog.tsx` - Settings dialog pattern

# fn-13-e55.1 Update Rust ShortcutsConfig schema with Vec<String> and new actions

## Description
Update `ShortcutsConfig` in Rust to use `Vec<String>` (max 2 bindings) per action instead of single `String`. Add new actions for all configurable shortcuts. Implement validation, normalization, and migration from old format.

**Size:** M
**Files:** `src-tauri/src/config/mod.rs`, `src-tauri/src/config/defaults.rs`

## Approach

- Follow migration pattern at `src-tauri/src/config/mod.rs:L490-516` (`migrate_legacy`)
- Follow normalization pattern at `src-tauri/src/config/mod.rs:L343-354` (MapConfig::normalize)
- Add `#[serde(default)]` per field for forward compatibility (memory pitfall)
- Check `is_finite()` before `clamp()` for any f64 values (memory pitfall)

## Key context

New action fields to add:
- Tools: select, pan, zoom, quick_zoom, draw, delete, merge, measure, move_section, move_station
- Edit: undo, redo, save
- View: toggle_depth_gradient, toggle_grid, toggle_satellite, toggle_labels, fit_to_bounds, zoom_in, zoom_out
- Panels: toggle_sections_panel, toggle_detail_panel, toggle_data_table

Shortcut format: "Ctrl+S", "Alt+Shift+Z", "S" (single key)
## Acceptance
- [ ] `ShortcutsConfig` fields are `Vec<String>` type
- [ ] New actions added for all categories (Tools, Edit, View, Panels)
- [ ] `normalize()` validates shortcut format, truncates to max 2
- [ ] Invalid shortcuts fall back to defaults with warning log
- [ ] `migrate_legacy()` converts old single-string format to array
- [ ] Unit tests for parsing valid/invalid shortcuts
- [ ] Unit tests for migration from old config
- [ ] `cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml` passes

# fn-13-e55.3 Create shortcut utilities module (platform, normalize, conflicts)

## Description
Create utilities module for shortcut handling: platform detection, key normalization, conflict detection, and display formatting.

**Size:** M
**Files:** `src/utils/shortcuts.ts`, `src/utils/__tests__/shortcuts.test.ts`

## Approach

- Platform detection: `/Mac|iPhone|iPad/.test(navigator.platform)` (practice-scout)
- Normalize: sort modifiers consistently (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Key order)
- Use `event.key.toLowerCase()` (existing pattern at `useKeyboardShortcuts.ts:L52`)
- Filter `event.repeat` to prevent multiple fires (practice-scout)

## Key context

Display symbols by platform:
- Mac: ⌘ (Meta), ⌥ (Alt), ⇧ (Shift), ⌃ (Ctrl)
- Windows/Linux: Ctrl, Alt, Shift
## Acceptance
- [ ] `isMac()` returns platform detection
- [ ] `normalizeShortcut(shortcut: string)` sorts modifiers consistently
- [ ] `parseKeyEvent(event: KeyboardEvent)` extracts normalized shortcut string
- [ ] `findConflict(shortcut: string, registry: Map)` returns conflicting action or null
- [ ] `formatShortcut(shortcut: string)` returns platform-appropriate display
- [ ] Unit tests for all functions
- [ ] `pnpm tsc --noEmit` passes

## Description
Create ShortcutRecorder component for capturing keyboard input. Shows recording state, handles Escape to cancel, displays keyboard-style badges.

**Size:** M
**Files:** `src/components/Settings/ShortcutRecorder.tsx`, `src/components/Settings/__tests__/ShortcutRecorder.test.tsx`

## Approach

- Similar to react-hotkeys-hook `useRecordHotkeys` pattern (github-scout)
- Click to enter recording mode, keydown captures combo, keyup completes
- Use utilities from fn-13-e55.3 for normalization and display
- Follow existing component patterns

## Key context

- Blocked keys: F1-F12, Tab, Caps Lock, Meta (OS key)
- Escape cancels recording, restores previous value
- Show "Click to record" placeholder when empty
- Keyboard badge styling: subtle rounded bg, border
- ARIA: role="button", aria-pressed for recording state, aria-live for announcements
